sentences.text: Beauty Shop is a 2005 American comedy film directed by Bille Woodruff .	Bille Woodruff	Bille Woodruff	comedy film	comedy film

The film serves as a spin-off of the Barbershop film franchise , and stars Queen Latifah as Gina , a character first introduced in the 2004 film Barbershop 2 : Back in Business .	Queen Latifah	Queen Latifah	spin-off	Spin-off (media)	Barbershop	Barbershop (film)
